name: Finance
tagline: Bills, subscriptions and cash flow in one view, with a check first
description: The boring parts of household money, kept visible: which bills are due, which subscriptions keep renewing, and how cash flow looks this month. Anything out of line gets flagged rather than buried. Before it touches money or contacts a bank on your behalf, it stops and asks you first.
author: stevenvillarino
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
